rows.abstract: Rationale: Past election experiences reveal that granting exemptions from the 'gun ban" and prohibitions on the use of bodyguards provided opportunities to candidates with private armies to create unncessary violence and wreak havoc during the election period. rows.author: B030
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 15 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8282, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE 'SOCIAL SECURITY ACT OF 1997'(RE: PR OVISIONS ON DEATH BENEFITS)
rows.abstract: Rationale: To provide a really meaningful protection to its members and beneficiaries, the provisions of the Social Security Act on death benefits must be amended anew. Benefits that are due to an applicant must not only be delivered --- they must be delivered expeditiously so as to serve its purpose of providing protection to the people against the contingencies of life. Provides for the following --- "SEC. 15. Nontranferabili ty of Benefit. - The SSS shall promptly pay the benefits provided for in this Act to such persons as may be entitled thereto in accordance with the provisions of this Act and shall impose only the minimum and necessary requirements as proof of an applicant's entitlement thereto: Provided, That the SSS shall pqay thee death benefits immediately after the death of the member to qualified beneficiaries who have submitted the necessary documents: Provided, further, That as proof of death of the member, the death certificate or an equivalent thereof shall suffice."

rows.abstract: Rationale: The promise of a highly efficient and competent police force, as provided in Republic Act No. 6975 enacted in 1990, has not been achieved. The performance of the Philippine National Police has been dismal. The peace and order situation ahs remained a very serious problem. There is a steady rise of incidence of major crimes, like kidnapping, robberies, carnapping, hold-ups, etc. And the worst part is that police response to crime occurrences is very poor. The situation leaves people covering in fear that they may become the next victims of crime. > At this point, the Philippine National Police has a tarnished image. The people have lost respect for it and this consequently breeds crimes. The Philippine National Police has to be rreformed if it wants to serve the people with dedication and efficiency. > Contains significant provisions, such as on: (1) Amending the COMPOSITION of the National Police Commission and the TERM OF OFFICE of the Commission; (2) A Qualifications Upra
